thresholdLineage.rule: Reuse its already-frozen grid, positive-basin, repeat-stability and pose tolerances. Only the obsolete Prompt 2 freshness prerequisite is superseded by the immutable P3 Stage F-Final PASS.

fixedGridContract.exactAnchorRule: Exactly one candidate at longitudinal=0 mm, lateral=0 mm, yaw=0 degrees per control is declared and attempted.
fixedGridContract.symmetryRule: Within every anchor/stage/center group, each nonzero offset has its exact negated offset.
fixedGridContract.widerNeighborhood: Every anchor has predeclared signed wider offsets on lateral, longitudinal and yaw axes; no outcome-triggered extension is allowed.

refinement.selectionRule: For each anchor, select the passing coarse/wider candidate with greatest minimum repeat score; ties resolve by candidateId ascending.
refinement.templateRule: The frozen refinement template is the complete 3x3x3 Cartesian product of one negative, zero and one positive value on each of longitudinal, lateral and yaw. The all-zero slot is a repeated measurement of the selected physical center, not a distinct topology cell.
refinement.materializationRule: The initial manifest contains exactly 212 absolute base candidates and the 27-slot relative template. After all base results are sealed, a coarse snapshot and deterministic selection manifest materialize exactly 108 refinement attempts and are hashed/indexed before the first refinement capture. Only the 104 nonzero refinement offsets count as new topology cells.

positiveBasinGate.representativeSelection: Highest minimum repeat score in each eligible connected component; ties by candidateId ascending.

structuralVariationGate.rule: At least one pair of accepted images from distinct cells in the eligible connected component must exceed the frozen repeat-noise RMS cutoff, while repeats within each cell remain below the frozen stability limits. Exact duplicate cross-cell images cannot establish variation.

snapshotInterface.initialManifestInterface: mapCandidates contains exactly the 212 base candidates; refinement.offsetTemplate contains exactly 27 relative offsets and declares the two refinement artifact filenames.
snapshotInterface.coarseSnapshotInterface: Contains only the 212 base candidate results, its parent manifest SHA-256, completion marker and a raw SHA-256 bound by the selection manifest and final seal.
snapshotInterface.refinementSelectionInterface: Contains parent manifest/coarse snapshot/protocol/source hashes, four deterministic selected centers, and exactly 108 materialized refinement attempts. Every zero-offset attempt has role=selected_center_repeat and countsAsDistinctCell=false; every nonzero attempt has countsAsDistinctCell=true.
snapshotInterface.seal: complete=true, immutable=true, failureSnapshot=false; all indexed paths/sizes/SHA-256 plus manifest/report/index/source/protocol/scene/evaluator identities must match.

overallGate: PASS only when immutable integrity, exact fixed-grid coverage, real direct-producer freshness, every attempted/rejected candidate accounting rule, at least one three-cell connected acceptable component, stable interior representative repeats and structural cross-cell variation all pass.
